scoring_justification: Checker recomputes stable x position and energy barrier from the raw CSV and compares to paper reference values with tolerance; no self-reported numbers are trusted.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference for stable Li positions and energy barriers for models A, B, C
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values read from the published figure; approximate but within stated tolerances
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual findings; tolerances are wide enough to accommodate implementation spread.

units.x: dimensionless, fraction of lattice parameter a

outputs.description: Raw total electronic energy profiles for the three models. The checker will extract for each model the x position of the energy minimum and the energy barrier (E(x=0.5) - E(min)) and compare to hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The agent must not report the extracted minima or barriers as separate artifacts; the checker recomputes them directly from this CSV. The absolute energy zero may be arbitrary but must be consistent within each model.

steps.description: Extract stable Li position (x of minimum energy) and energy barrier (E(x=0.5)-E(min)) for each model; score by closeness to paper reference.
